name: Workspace: Unsaved changes and compare dialogs

accessibility: The comparison is a table with column headings, and an absent value says Not set in words.
constraints: Built only from Adapter Widgets (Panel dialog, Stack, Text, Table, TableRow, Button); no Widget outside the Adapter catalog.
The two dialogs are two Panels; the compared fields and values are sample Locale data; the Workspace pages that open them are other Views.
Every visible string is bound with $i18n except the compared keys and values; en-US and zh-TW keep identical key sets.
Visual language follows the Quiet Canvas design system in DESIGN.md.
entryConditions: A member with unsaved edits on Locales or Settings followed a link to another page, or pressed Compare on the alert of a revision conflict.
The base state is Leave without saving? for three unsaved changes.
The render context selects one Workspace viewport preset, one Locale and one theme; the dialog is centered over a dimmed ground.
spec.intent: Show the two dialogs the Workspace authoring pages (Locales, Assets, Settings) share, as built from Adapter Widgets only: the confirmation before leaving a page with unsaved changes, and the comparison of the saved version with the draft after a revision conflict.
interactionRules: Leave without saving? says how many unsaved changes would be lost and offers Keep editing or Discard and leave; it has no close button and does not close on a click outside, so the choice is explicit.

Compare versions lists each field that differs, with the saved (theirs) and the draft (yours) value, Not set where one side lacks it; Keep theirs reloads the saved version and Keep mine carries the draft onto the newer revision, still unsaved.
After a revision conflict nothing is merged or sent again by itself: the Workbench keeps the draft, shows what changed and waits for the person to choose.
